info.background_text:
A genius commander who wants to become an adult..
With the exceptional strategic and tactical skills she inherited from her grandmother, a legendary soldier,Beryl rose to the position of commander at a young age. She constantly strives to become an “exemplary soldier" or a "trustworthy captain.” However, she often struggles to hide her childlike side,such as her obsession with chocolate bars or her tendency to resort to force when things get too complicated.
